result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks that are directly adjacent to the roadway without any buffer or protective elements. The environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and traffic calming measures, while utility poles create physical obstructions within the limited walking space.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are positioned directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, significantly reducing the effective walking width and accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street along the sidewalk path

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible, which may lead to unpredictable crossing behavior and higher risk from vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalks to meet accessibility standards and relocate utility poles to a furniture zone to ensure a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential sidewalk directly adjacent to a street with parallel parking. The environment lacks buffers, street lighting, or greenery, and the sidewalk pavement shows signs of wear and minor obstructions.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven slabs on the sidewalk create a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: No physical separation or planting strip between the narrow sidewalk and the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible curb line.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and resurface the sidewalk to remove tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the roadway and no physical buffer. The environment lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection, such as marked crosswalks or signals, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, which reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility ladder or continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous concrete sidewalk that is in a state of significant disrepair with numerous cracks and uneven surfaces. There is no buffer between the walkway and the roadway, and the overall streetscape lacks visible lighting, contributing to a neglected atmosphere.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk has significant cracking and uneven slabs, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians walk directly adjacent to the roadway without any physical separation or buffer zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of sidewalk along the curb

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Replace cracked and uneven concrete slabs to provide a smooth and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the road.
